purpose: Preserve prior telemetry/voice ideas that materially extend the current state-intelligence-communication design.

recovered_ideas.name: EXECUTION_STEP_TELEMETRY
recovered_ideas.summary: Where durable events exist, normalize execution observations with step_id, component, start_ts, end_ms, status and tags, then derive p50/p95 and outliers by stage/session instead of relying on narrative timing. Reuse E0-E9 / E9 exit audit owners rather than creating a second telemetry truth.

recovered_ideas.name: COGNITIVE_DEPTH_EXECUTION_CLASSIFICATION
recovered_ideas.summary: Distinguish what actually happened cognitively/execution-wise so metrics do not confuse one synthesis with real parallel workers.

recovered_ideas.name: VOICE_NOTE_CONTEXT_ENVELOPE
recovered_ideas.summary: When voice input becomes the normal Primary Chat input, persist contextual metadata sufficient to reconstruct what the human was looking at without making UI state authoritative.
recovered_ideas.boundary: Raw/private audio and transcript stay in the private ingress/storage boundary; public projection carries only sanitized references/derived state.

recovered_ideas.name: REALITY_GAP_FEEDBACK
recovered_ideas.summary: Use repeated human corrections/frustration as evidence that a reusable gate, metric, generator or missing category may be absent. The repair target is the class of failure, not merely the current instance.

integration_rule: These are candidate/recovered ideas, not authority. Any implementation must map them to CURRENT owners and prove reuse before adding writes or schemas.
